name: cinecode
cost: Free (MIT). Narration can use your own Gemini key (it has a free quota) or ElevenLabs
works_with: Claude Code (desktop app, VS Code extension or terminal) and Cursor
short: A skill that has your coding agent write, animate in code, score and render a finished MP4 from a one-line idea.
what: cinecode is a skill for coding agents that makes short films, long YouTube videos, ads, explainers and music videos. You give the idea and the taste. The agent writes the script, builds every frame in code with three.js in headless Chrome, designs the sound, mixes it to -14 LUFS and hands you an MP4. It has a Quick mode for a film today and a six-step Film mode for one piece that has to be as good as it can be.
who: Anyone who wants to make video with a coding agent, including people who have never written code. The main README is in Turkish, with an English version beside it. Skip it if you only use a chat app in the browser, because it needs an agent that can run tools on your computer.
needs: Node.js 22+, Python 3.9+, ffmpeg and Google Chrome (or Chromium or Edge). The agent offers to install what is missing and asks first
A GPU that Chrome can use: any recent Mac, or a PC with a working graphics driver
A few hundred MB of disk for Quick mode, and a few GB per film for Film mode
Optional: a Gemini API key for narration

steps.title: Install it by asking your agent
steps.text: In Claude Code, say: "Install the cinecode skill from https://github.com/sarpstar/cinecode". It clones the kit into `~/.claude/skills/cinecode`. Then open a new chat. Install it in one place only.

steps.title: Start a film in an empty folder
steps.text: From a terminal, then type "I want to make a short film". In the desktop app or VS Code, open an empty folder and type the same sentence.

steps.title: Answer the questions and approve each checkpoint
steps.text: Pick a mode and a purpose, answer one or two short rounds of questions, and approve or change things at each checkpoint. The finished film lands at the top of the film's folder as `<title>.mp4`.

try.label: From the README
try.text: Let's make a film with cinecode: <what it is about, a sentence or two>. Add the length, where it will be shown, the sound and the look if you know them, or leave them out and the kit asks.

watch: The agent installs missing tools such as Node, Python, ffmpeg or git, after asking you.
API keys you enter are stored in `~/.cinecode/keys.env`, outside any film folder or repository.
A 30 to 60 second Quick film usually takes 100 to 250 agent steps. The kit offers a fresh chat to keep token use down, and `python3 tools/usage.py` shows each chat's tokens in Claude Code.
The guard hooks that catch mistakes run only in Claude Code, and need version 2.1.295 or newer.

The kit only takes public-domain, CC0 and CC BY material, plus CC BY-SA for images, and writes a credits file. You are still responsible for licences on anything you publish, and your own logos, footage and songs are your responsibility.
A whole film made on Windows has not been tried yet.
